configuration_selection: Before final evaluation, maximize development mixed_revisit post_E mean utility: (old accepted_correct -4*old accepted_wrong)/(2g) - unseen_false_accept/128 +0.5*protected_old accepted_correct/g. Equal weight for both sizes/worlds. Ties within1e-12: lower exploration frequency then higher drop threshold, then grid index. Other strategies are development controls, not separate tunable configurations. No claim that this subjective scalar is universal; report every component and all four grid rows. No final-data tuning.
ss_core: Unchanged v0.1 concat512 shared residual:4 independent128 complex phase blocks,4 labels,lr0.5,32768 coefficient bytes. Fixed mean unique-hit threshold0.5; no stricter vote gate, no model-prediction pseudo-teachers, no replay or exact table. Original ss_multicode files and v0.1 selection helper are byte-identical.
data: 4 complete fields with8 values each,4 labels, artificial key-label associations. Five disjoint label-balanced groups A/B/C/D/E of g keys. Pool is half of A and half of B, g contexts already taught in base. Other half of A/B protected from direct refresh.128 never-taught keys outside all groups. Changed world silently switches16 pool labels after base, four per old class. No further truth changes. Fixed word vocabulary, not natural language or novel-rule generalization.
timeline: Base A then B then C,4 passes each. Acquire16 teachers with checkpoints q4,q16; teach D2 passes on the live session; checkpoint post_D. Acquire another16 with checkpoints q20,q32; teach E2 passes live; checkpoint post_E. Each trajectory32 acquisition+4g background teachers. Background may never bypass acquisition budget to teach pool keys. No future truth or evaluation outcomes used in selection. Unlike v0.1, D is now interleaved into acquisition, not a side fork. Compare strategies within v0.2; do not equate final scores directly to v0.1.
selection: random_once: fixed hash order among acquisition-unvisited contexts. ambiguity_once: least mean top-two margin among unvisited. mixed: every explore_every requests starting index0, pick hash-first unvisited; otherwise ambiguity. revisit modes: indices3 modulo4 are possible revisit slots, non-overlapping with exploration slots. A visited candidate requires last teacher age>=64 learner updates, visits<2, post-teacher margin minus current margin>=drop_margin. Revisit least current margin among eligible; if none, choose ambiguity among unvisited. Store only visits,last_step,post_margin with context IDs; no past teacher labels or correctness flags in selection state. Exact ties use same hash order. Revisit checks use all pool scores; no oracle detection of true relapse. Maximum4 actual revisits in this timeline, at most2 visits per item.
controls: Five arms: random_once plus2x2 exploration/revisit factorial. Same base weights, pool, correct external teacher, teacher count, background order, H bytes, fixed acceptance. Selection compute and label-free ledger size measured separately. No-additional-teacher D/E control fitted once per base, reused across worlds/strategies/seeds. Whole pool and protected groups are comparable; selected-item subsets and corrected cohorts differ by strategy.
execution: Development4configs*1data*2sizes*1code*2worlds*1acq*5arms=80 trajectories;2 shared bases and2 D/E controls;36352 actual teacher presentations. Final1config*4data*2sizes*2codes*2worlds*2acqs*5arms=320 trajectories;16 bases(18432),16 D/E controls(6144),320 acquisitions(10240),background branches(122880)=157696 actual teachers per full run. Two full final runs. At each size/world/arm:16 trajectories but only8 base data/code states; two acquisition seeds share base. Report paired descriptive differences and8 base-averaged deltas, not p-values on repeated probes.
limits: Only correct external teachers; source declaration is not authentication. No negative/unregistered teacher type added. No P1/S1 or language-core integration, partial observations, hidden dependency-mask search, biologically validated mechanism, OS security boundary or general error-free claim. Metadata and control remain ordinary Python/JSON. eligible_for_inference=false. Revisit benefit is a hypothesis, not a required outcome. Main success cannot be claimed from accepted_correct alone if errors/protected loss worsen.
